Division — Edit

Create divisions to track different departments or business segments.

Divisions enable separate reporting for different parts of your business.

Name

Enter the name of the division, such as 'North Region', 'Manufacturing Department', or 'Online Sales'.

Divisions help you track performance and profitability of different business segments independently.

Each transaction can be assigned to a division to build divisional financial statements.

Code

Enter an optional code for this division to make it easier to identify and select in reports and transactions.

Codes are useful for quick data entry and can follow your existing organizational structure.

Examples: 'NORTH', 'MFG', 'ONLINE', or use numeric codes like '100', '200', '300'.

Inactive

Mark this division as inactive to hide it from dropdown lists while preserving historical data.

Useful for closed divisions, discontinued operations, or temporarily suspended business segments.

Inactive divisions remain in historical reports but cannot be selected for new transactions.
